column1: # A labeled, synthetic set of shell calls for measuring the guard's incident
# kinds (docs/designs/guard.md, Part A). Each line: the kind the call should
# raise (or "none"), a tab, then the session's calls in order, separated by
# " ;; " (one tool call each). Written to look like ordinary agent work on a
# developer machine; no line comes from a real transcript.
